overview: This paper proposes FRE-RNN, a brain-inspired recurrent neural network with feedback regulation and residual connections, to accelerate convergence and improve the practicality of the Equilibrium Propagation (EP) learning framework.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Loading
modules.description: Handles loading, normalization, and batching for MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets, applying specific mean and standard deviation normalization for CIFAR-10 and preparing dataloaders for training and evaluation.

modules.name: FRE-RNN Layered Architecture
modules.description: Constructs the layered recurrent neural network with separate input and output layers, implementing feedforward and feedback weight scaling coefficients to regulate signal strength and accelerate convergence.

modules.name: FRE-RNN Convolutional Architecture
modules.description: Builds the CNN-embedded RNN topology, integrating feedforward convolutional and pooling layers with symmetric feedback transpose-convolutional and unpooling pathways, applying scaling factors to feedback connections.

modules.name: Deep RNN Topologies with Residual Connections
modules.description: Implements long-range skip-layer residual connections for deep symmetric RNNs and stochastic Arbitrary Graph Topology (AGT) with configurable connection probabilities for asymmetric RNNs to mitigate the vanishing gradient problem.

modules.name: Equilibrium Propagation Iterative Dynamics
modules.description: Executes the two-phase state evolution of EP: the free phase (zero nudging) for inference and the weakly clamped phase (error nudging) for credit assignment, iterating until the network state converges to steady states.

modules.name: STDP-Compatible Weight Update Mechanism
modules.description: Computes local, biologically plausible weight updates using the contrast between the steady states of the clamped and free phases, alongside the standard output layer weight update based on prediction error.

modules.name: Training Workflow and Optimization
modules.description: Orchestrates the overall EP training loop, managing the sequential execution of free and clamped phases, applying local weight updates, and integrating Adam or SGD optimizers with cosine annealing learning rate scheduling.

modules.name: Dynamical Convergence Analysis
modules.description: Computes the Spectral Radius (SR) of the weight matrix and the Finite-Time Maximum Lyapunov Exponent (FTMLE) to quantify and analyze the stability, convergence speed, and chaotic properties of the RNN dynamics.

modules.name: Robustness Evaluation Module
modules.description: Evaluates model resilience by injecting Gaussian noise into network weights and time-varying noise into neural states during both training and inference, measuring the degradation in test accuracy.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Configures systematic experiments to evaluate the individual impacts of feedforward and feedback scaling coefficients, iteration steps, network depth, and residual connection probabilities on model performance and convergence time.

modules.name: Baseline Comparison Executor
modules.description: Implements and executes comparative training and evaluation runs against Backpropagation (BP), Feedback Alignment (FA), and Prototypical Equilibrium Propagation (P-EP) baselines under identical architectural constraints to benchmark accuracy and computational cost.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Logging
modules.description: Manages hyperparameter configurations, logs training metrics (accuracy, error, convergence time), and aggregates results for automated generation of LaTeX tables and convergence dynamics plots.
